name: 270L all-in-one
tagline: A 270 litre all-in-one heat pump with DC inverter technology.
summary: The Emerald all-in-one heat pump puts the tank and heat pump in a single unit. Its DC inverter technology is designed to extend component life and keep noise down.
A simple controller lets you set the water temperature, pick a running mode and schedule heating times.

image.alt: Emerald Energy 270L white all-in-one heat pump

highlights.title: DC inverter technology
highlights.text: Efficient inverter operation that helps components last longer and reduces noise.

highlights.title: Silent mode
highlights.text: Runs the heat pump at a lower frequency for one quieter heating cycle.

highlights.title: Booster mode
highlights.text: Runs at a higher heating capacity for one cycle when you need hot water sooner.

highlights.title: Timer control
highlights.text: Set up to three timer periods so the system heats when it suits you.

highlights.title: Daily legionella control
highlights.text: Heats at least 45% of the tank to 60ºC every day, whatever the controller settings.
